processing.support: all bilinear contributors must be usable; no inpainting or target alignment

limitations: Qualitative inspection only; no confirmed motion, photometric variability or discovery.
No PSF matching, background subtraction or significance map; blending and unflagged artifacts remain possible.
WCS reprojection alone does not establish registration. Playback requires separate reference checks.
CWAVE/CBAND screening is not equality of spectral response functions.
The requested centre is a search position, not a propagated position or a detected source.

coverage.note: Detector-axis extents and tangent-plane area; not a north-up rectangular footprint. SIP WCS retained in original FITS.

background.method: Median of all valid pixels; includes sources and diffuse emission. Display diagnostic, not fitted sky or subtracted background.

diagnostics.interpretation: Masked values are not evidence of a dead detector. Finite unflagged values may still include noise or artifacts; no pixel-level astrophysical classification is established.

native_frames.orientation: Native detector axes; x right, y up. Not north up.

native_frames.processing: No reprojection, interpolation, inpainting, background subtraction or PSF matching. Original arrays unchanged.

survey_timeline.alignment: Common requested ICRS grid; registration is not assumed verified.
survey_timeline.display_policy: Shared sequence limits; wavelength-dependent differences must not be interpreted as variability.
survey_timeline.reason: At least two prepared observations are required for chronological playback.

matched_wavelength.comparison_scope: Qualitative matched-wavelength inspection; no established physical change.
matched_wavelength.alignment: Not verified for a usable matched subset.
matched_wavelength.display_policy: Shared sequence limits; no PSF matching or calibrated photometry.
matched_wavelength.reason: No two prepared epochs passed all required wavelength, support and stationary-reference checks. Inspect the Survey Timeline or individual observations; rejected comparisons remain in the receipt.

interpretation: No measured motion or calibrated variability is established.
selection_strategy: Explicit original identities; no archive substitution.
